<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    水平条形图模板
    用途: 类别排名、数值对比（适合类别名称较长的场景）
    适用场景: 销售排行榜、品牌认知度、满意度评分
    支持: 8个条形（可调整为5-12个）
    与柱状图区别: 水平展示，更适合排名和类别名较长的数据
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 条形渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#42A5F5;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#66BB6A;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#FFB74D;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="hbarShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="1" dy="0"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.2"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>品牌认知度排行榜</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年消费者调研报告 · 样本量 N=5,000</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- X轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="480" y1="140" x2="480" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="660" y1="140" x2="660" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="840" y1="140" x2="840" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1020" y1="140" x2="1020" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1200" y1="140" x2="1200" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- X轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="300" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>0%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="480" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>20%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="660" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>40%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="840" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>60%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1020" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>80%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1200" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>100%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Y轴基线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="620" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="300" y1="620" x2="1200" y2="620" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 条形数据 (条高36px, 间距24px, 总间距60px) -->
        
        <!-- 条形1: 品牌A - 92% (第1名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="175" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌A (市场领导者)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="155" width="828" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="1138" y="179" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>92%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形2: 品牌B - 78% (第2名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="235" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌B (新锐品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="215" width="702" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="1012" y="239" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>78%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形3: 品牌C - 65% (第3名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="295" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌C (经典品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="275" width="585" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="895" y="299" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>65%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形4: 品牌D - 52% (第4名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="355" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌D (区域品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="335" width="468" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="778" y="359" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>52%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形5: 品牌E - 45% (第5名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="415" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌E (性价比品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="395" width="405" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="715" y="419" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>45%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形6: 品牌F - 38% (第6名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="475" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌F (高端品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="455" width="342" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="652" y="479" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>38%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形7: 品牌G - 25% (第7名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="535" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌G (新进入者)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="515" width="225" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="535" y="539" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>25%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形8: 其他 - 12% (第8名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="595" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>其他品牌</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="575" width="108" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="418" y="599" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>12%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend">
        <rect x="60" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)"/>
        <text x="85" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>高认知度 (≥50%)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="240" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)"/>
        <text x="265" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>中等认知度 (30-50%)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="450" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)"/>
        <text x="475" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>低认知度 (<30%)</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="1220" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="14" fill="#95A5A6" text-anchor="end">
        <tspan>数据来源: 市场研究部门</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    水平条形图模板
    用途: 类别排名、数值对比（适合类别名称较长的场景）
    适用场景: 销售排行榜、品牌认知度、满意度评分
    支持: 8个条形（可调整为5-12个）
    与柱状图区别: 水平展示，更适合排名和类别名较长的数据
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 条形渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#42A5F5;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#66BB6A;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#FFB74D;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="hbarShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="1" dy="0"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.2"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>品牌认知度排行榜</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年消费者调研报告 · 样本量 N=5,000</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- X轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="480" y1="140" x2="480" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="660" y1="140" x2="660" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="840" y1="140" x2="840" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1020" y1="140" x2="1020" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>

        <!-- X轴刻度标签 -->

              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>0%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="480" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>20%</tspan>

            <tspan>40%</tspan>

            <tspan>60%</tspan>

        <line x1="300" y1="620" x2="1200" y2="620" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 条形数据 (条高36px, 间距24px, 总间距60px) -->

        <text x="290" y="175" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌A (市场领导者)</tspan>

        <rect x="300" y="155" width="828" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>

              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>92%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形2: 品牌B - 78% (第2名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="235" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌B (新锐品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="215" width="702" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="1012" y="239" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>78%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形3: 品牌C - 65% (第3名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="295" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌C (经典品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="275" width="585" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="895" y="299" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>65%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形4: 品牌D - 52% (第4名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="355" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌D (区域品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="335" width="468" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="778" y="359" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>52%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形5: 品牌E - 45% (第5名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="415" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">

        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="395" width="405" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="715" y="419" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>45%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形6: 品牌F - 38% (第6名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="475" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌F (高端品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="455" width="342" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="652" y="479" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>38%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形7: 品牌G - 25% (第7名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="535" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌G (新进入者)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="515" width="225" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="535" y="539" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>25%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形8: 其他 - 12% (第8名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="595" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>其他品牌</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="575" width="108" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="418" y="599" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>12%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend">
        <rect x="60" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 内容页 - 麦肯锡风格 (精装版) -->
    
    <defs>
        <linearGradient id="headerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#005587"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0076A8"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- 顶部渐变装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="5" fill="url(#headerGrad)"/>

    <!-- 页眉区域 -->
    <rect x="0" y="5" width="1280" height="75" fill="#FAFBFC"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="80" x2="1280" y2="80" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- 章节编号标签 -->
    <rect x="60" y="22" width="50" height="40" fill="#005587" rx="4"/>
    <text x="85" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">{{SECTION_NUM}}</text>

    <!-- 页面标题 -->
    <text x="130" y="52" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        {{PAGE_TITLE}}
    </text>

    <!-- 右侧章节指示 -->
    <text x="1160" y="52" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">{{SECTION_NAME}}</text>

    <!-- 核心观点条 (Key Insight Bar) -->
    <rect x="60" y="100" width="1160" height="50" fill="#FFF8E1" stroke="#F5A623" stroke-width="1" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="60" y="100" width="5" height="50" fill="#F5A623" rx="2"/>
    <text x="85" y="132" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#E89207">💡 KEY INSIGHT</text>
    <text x="220" y="132" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">{{KEY_MESSAGE}}</text>

    <!-- 内容区域 - 灵活布局 -->
    <!-- 
        AI 灵活布局区
        可用空间: x=60, y=170, width=1160, height=450
        
        常用布局模式：
        - 左右分栏 (520+520 或 400+640)
        - 上下分栏 
        - 2×2 矩阵 (280×210 每格)
        - 数据卡片组合 (150×120 每个)
        - 漏斗图/时间轴
        - 表格 (带边框)
    -->
    <rect x="60" y="170" width="1160" height="450" fill="none" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="8,6" rx="6"/>
    <text x="640" y="385" text-anchor="middle" fill="#BDC3C7" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18">
        {{CONTENT_AREA}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="415" text-anchor="middle" fill="#D5DBDB" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14">
        Content Area: 1160 × 450 px
    </text>

    <!-- 常用设计元素指南 -->
    <!-- 
        数据卡片: 
        <rect fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1.5" rx="6"/>
        <rect x="" y="" width="4" fill="#005587"/> (左侧装饰条)
        
        关键数据: 
        <text fill="#F5A623" font-size="44" font-weight="bold"/> (正向)
        <text fill="#E74C3C" font-size="44" font-weight="bold"/> (负向)
        
        问题标注圆点: 
        <circle r="8" fill="#E74C3C"/>
        
        分隔线: 
        <line stroke="#ECF0F1" stroke-width="1"/>
    -->

    <!-- 页脚区域 -->
    <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="80" fill="#FAFBFC"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="640" x2="1280" y2="640" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="60" y="675" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#95A5A6">Source: {{SOURCE}}</text>
    
    <!-- 备注区 -->
    <text x="60" y="700" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#BDC3C7">{{NOTE}}</text>

    <!-- 页码 -->
    <rect x="1140" y="655" width="80" height="30" fill="#005587" rx="4"/>
    <text x="1180" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">{{PAGE_NUM}}</text>

</svg>

    <text x="85" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">08</text>
    <text x="130" y="52" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        Key Takeaways: Prioritizing Evidence-Based Action
    </text>
    <text x="1160" y="52" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D">Policy Implications</text>

    <!-- Takeaway items with numbered badges and colored bars -->
    <!-- Takeaway 1 -->
    <rect x="60" y="105" width="1160" height="85" fill="#F0F7F6" stroke="#00796B" stroke-width="1" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="60" y="105" width="5" height="85" fill="#00796B" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="80" y="122" width="36" height="36" fill="#00796B" rx="18"/>
    <text x="98" y="147" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
    <text x="135" y="135" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">Depression and anxiety dominate</text>
    <text x="135" y="160" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A">Together they represent ~80% of mental health DALYs across the five major categories.</text>

    <!-- Takeaway 2 -->
    <rect x="60" y="200" width="1160" height="85" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#005587" stroke-width="1" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="60" y="200" width="5" height="85" fill="#005587" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="80" y="217" width="36" height="36" fill="#005587" rx="18"/>
    <text x="98" y="242" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
    <text x="135" y="230" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">Severe conditions carry disproportionate individual burden</text>
    <text x="135" y="255" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A">Schizophrenia (210.2 DALYs) and bipolar disorder (94.6 DALYs) affect fewer people but cause severe disability.</text>

    <!-- Takeaway 3 -->
    <rect x="60" y="295" width="1160" height="85" fill="#FFF8E1" stroke="#F5A623" stroke-width="1" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="60" y="295" width="5" height="85" fill="#F5A623" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="80" y="312" width="36" height="36" fill="#F5A623" rx="18"/>
    <text x="98" y="337" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
    <text x="135" y="325" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">Treatment exists but access and quality remain inadequate</text>
    <text x="135" y="350" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A">The treatment gap is driven by stigma, poor access (especially in low-income countries), and inadequate quality of care.</text>

    <!-- Takeaway 4 -->
    <rect x="60" y="390" width="1160" height="85" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#8A9AAA" stroke-width="1" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="60" y="390" width="5" height="85" fill="#8A9AAA" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="80" y="407" width="36" height="36" fill="#8A9AAA" rx="18"/>
    <text x="98" y="432" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
    <text x="135" y="420" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">Stigma suppresses help-seeking and accurate data</text>
    <text x="135" y="445" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A">Discomfort disclosing symptoms means the true burden of mental illness is likely underestimated in global data.</text>

    <!-- Takeaway 5 -->
    <rect x="60" y="485" width="1160" height="85" fill="#F0F7F6" stroke="#00796B" stroke-width="2" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="60" y="485" width="5" height="85" fill="#00796B" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="80" y="502" width="36" height="36" fill="#00796B" rx="18"/>
    <text x="98" y="527" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
    <text x="135" y="515" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">Policy should prioritize scaling interventions for common disorders while maintaining specialized care</text>
    <text x="135" y="540" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5A6A7A">Evidence-based interventions for depression and anxiety should be scaled globally; schizophrenia and bipolar require sustained specialized services.</text>

    <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="80" fill="#FAFBFC"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="640" x2="1280" y2="640" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="60" y="675" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#95A5A6">Source: Our World in Data / IHME Global Burden of Disease (2023)</text>
    <rect x="1140" y="655" width="80" height="30" fill="#005587" rx="4"/>

arguments.content:
# 01_cover

This presentation provides a data-driven overview of global mental health conditions, their disease burden measured in DALYs, and the persistent gap between need and treatment. All data comes from the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation's Global Burden of Disease study, published via Our World in Data. The audience is public health policy analysts and mental health program planners.

Duration: 30 seconds (intro slide)

---

# 02_prevalence

[Transition] Let's begin with the scale of the problem.

Mental health conditions affect hundreds of millions of people worldwide. Lifetime major depression risk is substantial: one in three women and one in five men will experience major depression at some point in their lives. [Pause] These are not rare conditions — they are widespread across populations globally.

Other conditions such as schizophrenia and bipolar disorder are less common but carry severe individual impact. This matters for policy: systems must address both the high-prevalence, high-burden common disorders like depression and anxiety, as well as maintain specialized care for the less common but more severe conditions.

Key points: (1) 1 in 3 women and 1 in 5 men face lifetime major depression (2) Common disorders (depression, anxiety) affect the most people (3) Severe conditions require specialized care alongside common disorder interventions
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 03_burden_by_category

[Transition] To understand where policy investment has the greatest population impact, let's look at disease burden by mental illness category.

This horizontal bar chart shows DALYs — disability-adjusted life years — per 100,000 people for five major mental illness categories. [Data] Depressive disorders account for 694.6 DALYs per 100,000 and anxiety disorders for 686.5 — nearly identical and dominating the chart. [Pause]

Schizophrenia contributes 210.2 DALYs, bipolar disorder 94.6, and eating disorders 47.5. Together, depression and anxiety represent roughly 80% of the total mental health disease burden across these five categories. This data makes clear where population-level intervention has the greatest reach.

Key points: (1) Depression and anxiety dominate with ~690 DALYs each (2) Together they account for ~80% of total mental health DALYs (3) Schizophrenia carries disproportionate individual burden relative to prevalence
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 04_depression_vs_anxiety

[Transition] Given that depression and anxiety dominate the data, let's examine their burden more closely.

Depression and anxiety carry nearly equal disease burden worldwide. Depression generates 694.6 DALYs per 100,000 and anxiety 686.5 — a difference of only about 8 points, or roughly 1.2 percent. [Pause]

The near-parity is striking and has important policy implications. Both disorders require comparable levels of clinical attention and resource allocation. A health system that invests heavily in depression but neglects anxiety — or vice versa — is leaving significant burden unaddressed. [Data] Together they account for approximately 80 percent of total mental health DALYs across these five categories.

Key points: (1) Depression (694.6) and anxiety (686.5) are nearly equal in burden (2) Difference is only ~1.2% — they are functionally equivalent in population impact (3) Health systems must treat both equitably to address the majority of mental health burden
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 05_severe_conditions

[Transition] While depression and anxiety dominate population-level burden, let's look at the severe conditions.

The proportional stacked bar shows each category's share of total mental health DALYs. Depression and anxiety together make up roughly 80 percent. Schizophrenia accounts for about 12 percent, bipolar disorder 5 percent, and eating disorders 3 percent. [Pause]

But population-level numbers mask individual severity. Schizophrenia generates 210.2 DALYs per 100,000 — reflecting hallucinations, delusions, and cognitive impairment that cause profound disability. Bipolar disorder, at 94.6 DALYs, brings severe mood swings that disrupt every aspect of daily functioning.

The policy implication is clear: scale interventions for the high-burden common disorders while maintaining — not reducing — specialized services for schizophrenia and bipolar. Lower prevalence does not mean lower priority at the individual level.

Key points: (1) Schizophrenia and bipolar account for ~17% of total DALYs but carry high individual severity (2) Schizophrenia: 210.2 DALYs reflects profound disability from hallucinations and delusions (3) Policy must maintain specialized care for severe conditions while scaling common disorder interventions
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 06_treatment_gap

[Transition] Even when we know the burden, treatment is often unavailable or inadequate.

Mental illnesses are treatable — evidence-based interventions exist and work. Yet significant barriers prevent millions from receiving adequate care. [Pause]

Four barriers are consistently documented. First, stigma: many people feel uncomfortable disclosing symptoms to healthcare professionals or even people they know. Second, access: treatment is often lacking, especially in low- and middle-income countries. Third, quality: even where treatment exists, it may be of poor quality, failing to meet clinical standards. Fourth, underreporting: discomfort with disclosure makes it difficult to estimate true prevalence — the actual burden may be higher than reported figures suggest.

Good data is essential to understand these conditions, how many people are affected, and how they can be treated effectively and safely.

Key points: (1) Mental illness is treatable but four barriers prevent adequate care (2) Stigma, poor access, inadequate quality, and underreporting drive the treatment gap (3) The true burden may be underestimated due to underreporting
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 07_coping_strategies

[Transition] When formal treatment is unavailable or avoided, people use diverse informal coping strategies.

Global survey data reveals wide variation in how people deal with anxiety or depression. [Pause]

Three broad categories emerge. First, prescribed medication — common in higher-income settings, includes antidepressants and anxiolytics under professional supervision. Second, religious and spiritual activities — prevalent in many regions including Sub-Saharan Africa, the Middle East, and South Asia, where prayer, meditation, and faith-based counseling provide meaning and community. Third, talking to family and friends — widely reported across East Asia, Latin America, and Europe, where informal social support through trusted networks plays a major role.

The diversity of coping strategies underscores that mental health responses are shaped by cultural, economic, and healthcare system factors. Policy must account for these differences rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.

Key points: (1) Coping strategies fall into three broad categories: medication, spiritual/religious, and social support (2) Regional patterns reflect cultural, economic, and healthcare system differences (3) Policy must be culturally sensitive and adapt to local contexts
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 08_takeaways

[Transition] To conclude, here are five key takeaways for policy action.

First, depression and anxiety dominate — together they represent roughly 80 percent of mental health DALYs. Scaling evidence-based interventions for these two conditions will have the greatest population impact.

Second, schizophrenia and bipolar carry disproportionate individual burden. Fewer people are affected, but the disability per person is severe, requiring sustained specialized care.

Third, the treatment gap persists. Stigma, poor access, inadequate quality, and underreporting mean that even where treatments exist, they often fail to reach those who need them.

Fourth, stigma suppresses both help-seeking and accurate data. This means the true burden of mental illness is likely underestimated in global data — making the case for investment even stronger.

Fifth, policy should scale interventions for common disorders while maintaining specialized care for severe conditions. Both are necessary; neither is sufficient alone. [Pause]

Good data is essential. To understand these conditions — how, when, and why they occur, how many people are affected, and how they can be treated effectively — we need sustained investment in mental health surveillance and research.

Key points: (1) Scale evidence-based interventions for depression and anxiety (~80% of DALYs) (2) Maintain specialized care for schizophrenia and bipolar (high individual severity) (3) Address stigma, access, and quality to close the treatment gap (4) Invest in data and surveillance to capture true burden
Duration: 2 minutes

raw_arguments.content:
# 01_cover

This presentation provides a data-driven overview of global mental health conditions, their disease burden measured in DALYs, and the persistent gap between need and treatment. All data comes from the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation's Global Burden of Disease study, published via Our World in Data. The audience is public health policy analysts and mental health program planners.

Duration: 30 seconds (intro slide)

---

# 02_prevalence

[Transition] Let's begin with the scale of the problem.

Mental health conditions affect hundreds of millions of people worldwide. Lifetime major depression risk is substantial: one in three women and one in five men will experience major depression at some point in their lives. [Pause] These are not rare conditions — they are widespread across populations globally.

Other conditions such as schizophrenia and bipolar disorder are less common but carry severe individual impact. This matters for policy: systems must address both the high-prevalence, high-burden common disorders like depression and anxiety, as well as maintain specialized care for the less common but more severe conditions.

Key points: (1) 1 in 3 women and 1 in 5 men face lifetime major depression (2) Common disorders (depression, anxiety) affect the most people (3) Severe conditions require specialized care alongside common disorder interventions
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 03_burden_by_category

[Transition] To understand where policy investment has the greatest population impact, let's look at disease burden by mental illness category.

This horizontal bar chart shows DALYs — disability-adjusted life years — per 100,000 people for five major mental illness categories. [Data] Depressive disorders account for 694.6 DALYs per 100,000 and anxiety disorders for 686.5 — nearly identical and dominating the chart. [Pause]

Schizophrenia contributes 210.2 DALYs, bipolar disorder 94.6, and eating disorders 47.5. Together, depression and anxiety represent roughly 80% of the total mental health disease burden across these five categories. This data makes clear where population-level intervention has the greatest reach.

Key points: (1) Depression and anxiety dominate with ~690 DALYs each (2) Together they account for ~80% of total mental health DALYs (3) Schizophrenia carries disproportionate individual burden relative to prevalence
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 04_depression_vs_anxiety

[Transition] Given that depression and anxiety dominate the data, let's examine their burden more closely.

Depression and anxiety carry nearly equal disease burden worldwide. Depression generates 694.6 DALYs per 100,000 and anxiety 686.5 — a difference of only about 8 points, or roughly 1.2 percent. [Pause]

The near-parity is striking and has important policy implications. Both disorders require comparable levels of clinical attention and resource allocation. A health system that invests heavily in depression but neglects anxiety — or vice versa — is leaving significant burden unaddressed. [Data] Together they account for approximately 80 percent of total mental health DALYs across these five categories.

Key points: (1) Depression (694.6) and anxiety (686.5) are nearly equal in burden (2) Difference is only ~1.2% — they are functionally equivalent in population impact (3) Health systems must treat both equitably to address the majority of mental health burden
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 05_severe_conditions

[Transition] While depression and anxiety dominate population-level burden, let's look at the severe conditions.

The proportional stacked bar shows each category's share of total mental health DALYs. Depression and anxiety together make up roughly 80 percent. Schizophrenia accounts for about 12 percent, bipolar disorder 5 percent, and eating disorders 3 percent. [Pause]

But population-level numbers mask individual severity. Schizophrenia generates 210.2 DALYs per 100,000 — reflecting hallucinations, delusions, and cognitive impairment that cause profound disability. Bipolar disorder, at 94.6 DALYs, brings severe mood swings that disrupt every aspect of daily functioning.

The policy implication is clear: scale interventions for the high-burden common disorders while maintaining — not reducing — specialized services for schizophrenia and bipolar. Lower prevalence does not mean lower priority at the individual level.

Key points: (1) Schizophrenia and bipolar account for ~17% of total DALYs but carry high individual severity (2) Schizophrenia: 210.2 DALYs reflects profound disability from hallucinations and delusions (3) Policy must maintain specialized care for severe conditions while scaling common disorder interventions
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 06_treatment_gap

[Transition] Even when we know the burden, treatment is often unavailable or inadequate.

Mental illnesses are treatable — evidence-based interventions exist and work. Yet significant barriers prevent millions from receiving adequate care. [Pause]

Four barriers are consistently documented. First, stigma: many people feel uncomfortable disclosing symptoms to healthcare professionals or even people they know. Second, access: treatment is often lacking, especially in low- and middle-income countries. Third, quality: even where treatment exists, it may be of poor quality, failing to meet clinical standards. Fourth, underreporting: discomfort with disclosure makes it difficult to estimate true prevalence — the actual burden may be higher than reported figures suggest.

Good data is essential to understand these conditions, how many people are affected, and how they can be treated effectively and safely.

Key points: (1) Mental illness is treatable but four barriers prevent adequate care (2) Stigma, poor access, inadequate quality, and underreporting drive the treatment gap (3) The true burden may be underestimated due to underreporting
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 07_coping_strategies

[Transition] When formal treatment is unavailable or avoided, people use diverse informal coping strategies.

Global survey data reveals wide variation in how people deal with anxiety or depression. [Pause]

Three broad categories emerge. First, prescribed medication — common in higher-income settings, includes antidepressants and anxiolytics under professional supervision. Second, religious and spiritual activities — prevalent in many regions including Sub-Saharan Africa, the Middle East, and South Asia, where prayer, meditation, and faith-based counseling provide meaning and community. Third, talking to family and friends — widely reported across East Asia, Latin America, and Europe, where informal social support through trusted networks plays a major role.

The diversity of coping strategies underscores that mental health responses are shaped by cultural, economic, and healthcare system factors. Policy must account for these differences rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.

Key points: (1) Coping strategies fall into three broad categories: medication, spiritual/religious, and social support (2) Regional patterns reflect cultural, economic, and healthcare system differences (3) Policy must be culturally sensitive and adapt to local contexts
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 08_takeaways

[Transition] To conclude, here are five key takeaways for policy action.

First, depression and anxiety dominate — together they represent roughly 80 percent of mental health DALYs. Scaling evidence-based interventions for these two conditions will have the greatest population impact.

Second, schizophrenia and bipolar carry disproportionate individual burden. Fewer people are affected, but the disability per person is severe, requiring sustained specialized care.

Third, the treatment gap persists. Stigma, poor access, inadequate quality, and underreporting mean that even where treatments exist, they often fail to reach those who need them.

Fourth, stigma suppresses both help-seeking and accurate data. This means the true burden of mental illness is likely underestimated in global data — making the case for investment even stronger.

Fifth, policy should scale interventions for common disorders while maintaining specialized care for severe conditions. Both are necessary; neither is sufficient alone. [Pause]

Good data is essential. To understand these conditions — how, when, and why they occur, how many people are affected, and how they can be treated effectively — we need sustained investment in mental health surveillance and research.

Key points: (1) Scale evidence-based interventions for depression and anxiety (~80% of DALYs) (2) Maintain specialized care for schizophrenia and bipolar (high individual severity) (3) Address stigma, access, and quality to close the treatment gap (4) Invest in data and surveillance to capture true burden
Duration: 2 minutes

The presentation is complete. Final deck saved at `/app/output/final_deck.pptx` (71.7 KB).

**Summary of what was built:**

- **8 slides** following the specified structure from `task_input.json`
- **Slide 1** — Cover: McKinsey-style with title, subtitle, source attribution
- **Slide 2** — Prevalence: Large callout numbers (1 in 3 women, 1 in 5 men) with two styled stat cards
- **Slide 3** — Horizontal bar chart: DALYs per 100K for all 5 categories with proportional bar widths
- **Slide 4** — Depression vs anxiety parity: Paired vertical bars (694.6 vs 686.5) with ~80% combined share callout
- **Slide 5** — Severe conditions: Proportional stacked bar showing scale contrast + individual cards for schizophrenia (210.2) and bipolar (94.6)
- **Slide 6** — Treatment gap: 2×2 icon grid covering stigma, access, quality, and underreporting
- **Slide 7** — Coping strategies: 3-column cards for medication, spiritual/religious, and family/friends support
- **Slide 8** — Key takeaways: 5 numbered policy implications with color-coded takeaway bars

All statistics sourced directly from `source_brief.md` / IHME Global Burden of Disease 2023. Speaker notes embedded for all 8 slides.
